lights.name: screen
lights.kind: CRT screen (blue, area source); the BEAM (the light that matters)

lights.name: ceiling

intent: The camera looks out from behind the screen (0.45 m back, past the glass’s right edge on Dad’s side, a little high; monitor and computer hidden, the glass edge stays as a thin frame): her face lit cool white by the screen, nearly frontal; her EYES ARE ON HER OWN FINGERTIP on the glass (r4: her head looks exactly at the fingertip point, under the word); her RIGHT arm runs from her own shoulder, elbow low under her chest, to the fingertip (a 7-year-old’s small hand), clear of Dad. Long-sleeved grey sweater. Dad’s face and shoulder at frame left, beside and behind her. Locked off.

beam.name: CRT screen glow
beam.model: area source (the screen rectangle), radiating into +z; frustum spreading by half_angle from the rectangle, faded out at range
beam.corner_order: TL,TR,BR,BL as the screen is read
beam.falloff: inverse-square from an area source: full on faces 0.4-0.6 m away, about 1/10 at 1.5 m

floor.note: the desk top cuts the light: floor nearer the desk than desk_shadow_ends_z, and everything under the desk, is unlit

eye_deg.note: eyes relative to the head; travel clamped to +-35 yaw, 30 up / 45 down
